criteria.text: Flutter can move a task into Deferred.
The API accepts Deferred as an exact status filter.
Deferred is excluded from Open and included in All without regressing counts.
Electron/web renders Deferred after Done, moves tasks into it, excludes them from Open, and includes them in All.
